steps: Which teacher had the highest average grade in Fall 2025, and which students failed a course taught by that teacher
Which teacher had the highest average grade in Fall 2025, and which students failed a course taught by that teacher

changes.sql:
WITH teacher_avg AS (
  SELECT
    co.teacher_id,
    AVG(e.grade) AS avg_grade
  FROM enrollments e
  JOIN course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.id
  JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id
  WHERE s.name = 'Fall 2025' AND e.grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY co.teacher_id
),
top_teacher AS (
  SELECT teacher_id
  FROM teacher_avg
  ORDER BY avg_grade DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
failed_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.student_id
  FROM enrollments e
  JOIN course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.id
  JOIN semesters s ON co.semester_id = s.id
  JOIN top_teacher tt ON co.teacher_id = tt.teacher_id
  WHERE s.name = 'Fall 2025' AND e.grade IS NOT NULL AND e.grade < 60
)
SELECT
  t.id AS teacher_id,
  t.name AS teacher_name,
  s.id AS student_id,
  s.name AS student_name
FROM top_teacher tt
JOIN teachers t ON tt.teacher_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN failed_students fs ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN students s ON fs.student_id = s.id
ORDER BY s.id;
